## Source review

#5403, #5045 sprint review packet.

## Findings

- Emergency stop accepts any non-empty authorization string.
- API Gateway passed proof omits required routes and failure matrix.
- Serial final coherence gate #4906 remains blocked_with_evidence.

## Acceptance criteria

- Emergency stop verifies caller identity and governed authority with forgery tests.
- API Gateway proof exercises required routes and failure behavior or is downgraded to a bounded smoke.
- #4906 receives integrated closure or explicit operator-approved release disposition.
- WP-07 readiness consumers remain blocked until the final gate is truthful.
title: [v0.91.7][review-fix][WP-07] Resolve #5045 runtime hardening findings
